lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Cleaning the Car. Daddy Pig is taking the family for a drive in the country. Come on, is everybody ready? Ready! Yes, Daddy Pig, we're ready.
lines.zh: 洗车。猪爸爸要带全家去乡下兜风。来吧，大家都准备好了吗？准备好了！是的，猪爸爸，我们准备好了。

lines.en: But the car isn't ready. Look how messy it is! Oh, it's not too bad. You should see how messy it is inside.
lines.zh: 可是车还没准备好。看它多脏啊！哦，还不算太糟。你该看看里面有多乱。

lines.en: Naughty, messy Daddy! Naughty, messy Daddy!
lines.zh: 脏乱的调皮爸爸！脏乱的调皮爸爸！

lines.en: Look at all this rubbish! Newspapers? Those are mine. Sweets? They're mine. Mr. Dinosaur?
lines.zh: 看看这一堆垃圾！报纸？那是我的。糖果？是我的。恐龙先生呢？

lines.en: Dinosaur!
lines.zh: 恐龙！

lines.en: We must clean the car before we go for a drive. Oh, right you are, Mummy Pig. Mummy, can we help to clean the car? Yes, if you want to. Hooray!
lines.zh: 我们去兜风之前必须把车洗干净。哦，猪妈妈，你说得对。妈妈，我们能帮忙洗车吗？可以，如果你们想的话。太好啦！

lines.en: Daddy Pig has some warm soapy water to wash the car. Daddy Pig is washing the roof. Mummy Pig is washing the bonnet. Peppa is washing the doors. George wants to wash the windows, but he is too little. Poor George, let me help you.
lines.zh: 猪爸爸准备了一些温热的肥皂水来洗车。猪爸爸在洗车顶，猪妈妈在洗引擎盖，佩奇在洗车门。乔治想洗车窗，可他太小了。可怜的乔治，让我来帮你。

lines.en: Oh, dear. George has dropped his sponge in a muddy puddle.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。乔治把海绵掉进泥坑里了。

lines.en: George, you're making the car all muddy again! I will wash the mud off. Peppa, don't use the muddy water!
lines.zh: 乔治，你把车又弄得到处是泥了！我把泥冲掉。佩奇，别用那盆泥水！

lines.en: Oh, dear. Peppa has thrown the muddy water all over the car.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪。佩奇把泥水泼得整车都是。

lines.en: Oh, never mind, we can use the garden hose to clean it off. Yes, yes! Can I hold the hose?
lines.zh: 哦，没关系，我们可以用花园的水管把它冲干净。太好了，太好了！我能拿着水管吗？

lines.en: Peppa holds the hose, and Daddy Pig turns on the water. Where's the water?
lines.zh: 佩奇拿着水管，猪爸爸打开水龙头。水在哪儿呢？

lines.en: Stop, Peppa! Sorry, Mummy!
lines.zh: 停下，佩奇！对不起，妈妈！

lines.en: Oh! Daddy Pig, please turn off the water! Oh, no need to panic.
lines.zh: 哦！猪爸爸，请把水关掉！哦，不用慌。

lines.en: Oh, dear, everyone is wet! At least the car has been washed.
lines.zh: 哦，天哪，大家都湿透了！至少车洗干净了。

lines.en: We've all been washed! You go and dry yourselves while I polish the car. See you later! See you later!
lines.zh: 我们全都被洗了一遍！你们去把自己擦干，我来给车打蜡。待会儿见！待会儿见！

lines.en: Daddy Pig is polishing the car so well, he can see his face in it. What a funny face! Oh, more funny faces! It's Peppa and George and Mummy Pig!
lines.zh: 猪爸爸把车擦得那么亮，他都能在车上看见自己的脸了。多滑稽的一张脸！哦，还有更多滑稽的脸！是佩奇、乔治和猪妈妈！

lines.en: What a lovely shiny car! Yes, I am a bit of an expert at these things. Come on, I'll drive today. Is everybody ready? Ready! Then let's go!
lines.zh: 多漂亮、多闪亮的车呀！是啊，我在这方面的确算是行家。来吧，今天我来开车。大家都准备好了吗？准备好了！那我们出发！

lines.en: I hope you will all keep this car clean today. Yes, Mummy Pig. Yes, Mummy Pig.
lines.zh: 希望你们今天都能保持车内干净。好的，猪妈妈。好的，猪妈妈。

lines.en: Mummy, now you've made the car all muddy again! Naughty Mummy! Naughty, messy Mummy!
lines.zh: 妈妈，现在你把车又弄得到处是泥了！调皮的妈妈！脏乱的调皮妈妈！
